calls.head: The Mammoth hunt in packs
calls.body: On forecheck pressure, Utah is one of the league’s best, but Pittsburgh is the worst. They’re about as far apart as two teams get. Expect the Mammoth to win more pucks back deep in the Penguins’ end.
calls.call: The Mammoth put more forecheck pressure on than the Penguins.

surprises.head: Both teams played to type
surprises.body: Nothing in this game strayed far from how these two usually play: the shot share, the quality of chances, special teams, hitting, ice time and goaltending all landed inside their normal night-to-night range.

story.head: The Mammoth get past the Penguins
paras: Erik Karlsson struck first for the Penguins on the power play a little over a minute in. Clayton Keller and Kevin Stenlund scored just over four minutes apart early in the first to turn a 1-0 deficit into a 2-1 lead. Rickard Rakell tied it 2-2 for Pittsburgh on the power play early in the second. Nate Schmidt and Kailer Yamamoto scored just under three minutes apart midway through the period to put the Mammoth up 4-2. The Penguins’ Bryan Rust left in the second period and didn’t return. The next day, he was listed as day to day with a lower-body injury. Nick Schmaltz made it 5-2 for the Mammoth on the power play early in the third, and that goal turned out to be the winner. Egor Chinakhov cut Utah’s lead to 5-3 a little over a minute later, and Declan Carlile made it 5-4 with just over five minutes left.

The Mammoth carried the play, outshooting the Penguins 29-19, and got the result to match. Sebastian Cossa made 15 saves for the Mammoth, and Artūrs Šilovs allowed five goals on 29 shots. The Mammoth moved to 7-3-0 and climbed into first in the Central, while the Pens dropped to 3-6-1, sixth in the Metropolitan.

items.text: The Penguins are on a four-game losing streak.
With Samuel Girard out, Carlile took his spot and scored.
Erik Karlsson scored his first goal of the season, his first since Apr 9 (ten games played since).
John Marino was in NHL.com’s projected lineup, but Nick DeSimone played instead.
